throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: armrrx.w $r12, 14; armrrx.w $r13, 14; armrrx.w $r14, 14; armrrx.w $r15, 14; armrrx.w $r16, 14; armrrx.w $r17, 14; armrrx.w $r18, 14; armrrx.w $r19, 14
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'armmtflag $r0, 0x39' --asm 'armrrx.w $r12, 14; armrrx.w $r13, 14; armrrx.w $r14, 14; armrrx.w $r15, 14; armrrx.w $r16, 14; armrrx.w $r17, 14; armrrx.w $r18, 14; armrrx.w $r19, 14'
throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes take 16.00 cycles, i.e. 2 CPI. The instruction is a single uop; its conditional execution limits it to one per two cycles (armmfflag and armmove are not conditional on register data and run at one per cycle). Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on LA664, core 0, with --method slope (--unroll 250 --unroll2 1000) and confirmed with the 0x01 uop counter.

notes: LBT ARM-style instruction. Latency is recorded per register source operand and for the ARMFLAGS path. Only ARMFLAGS is written: the general-purpose registers are read-only sources for this instruction (verified with a native test program, where armadd.w, armsub.w, armand.w, armmov.w, armrotr.w and armrrx.w leave every GPR unchanged while ARMFLAGS changes; the conditional move armMove is the exception and does write its destination).
